thread:
Nina (partnerships): quick thread: partner (EdgeWave) wants an on-prem EAP for their SI customers. Requirements: NDA, short perf + thermal bench in their site, marketplace tile, and an embargoed co-demo. Who picks what?
Raj (eng-runtime): I can own the perf image and runbook. need kernel/driver matrix and a whitelist for health port.
Carmen (infra): agent-based onboarding preferred. I can scope/build the agent and presigned bucket flow. Ops note: no VPN.
Ivy (legal): I'll review NDA + export control language. will add embargo clause and telemetry ownership. ETA 48h.
Nina (partnerships): partner requested token-level sampling for debugging but insist on PII redaction. we should be strict about that.
Raj (eng-runtime): plan sketch:
- models: rdx-small/medium
- runs: calibration + 6h soak
- collect: p50/p95, GPU temp, power
- upload: presigned S3 (partner pushes)
Carmen (infra): DeployBot: create-presigned-bucket?
DeployBot: created s3://eap-edgewave-3199 (expires 30d). role: redwood-eap-agent-3199.
MarketplaceBot: Tile needs icon, 200-char blurb, deploy script, support contact. See docs/marketplace/onprem-guidelines.
Ben (solutions): I'll draft the marketplace copy and a stub terraform. Nina please give one-line positioning.
Nina (partnerships): draft line: "Redwood + EdgeWave: validated on-prem inference for regulated environments (EAP)." tweak as needed.
Ivy (legal): NDA sent 3199990002. please flag any redlines in 48h.
Raj (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a smoke test day-0 and a redaction pipeline for telemetry.
Carmen (infra): will share bootstrap script privately. example: `curl -fsSL https://install.redwood.ai/agent.sh | sudo bash -s -- --eap edgewave --out s3://eap-edgewave-3199`
Nina (partnerships): timeline ask: partner hopes for a 2-week window in June. Let's tentatively book June 15 start pending NDA + infra.
Ben (solutions): draft tile ready by May 30.
Ivy (legal): embargo clause added: mutual signoff required; public demo only after both parties approve within 30 days.
Nina (partnerships): action list: @Ivy NDA by 48h; @Carmen agent + bucket; @Raj runbook + smoke test; @Ben marketplace draft. I'll coordinate partner comms and hold press.
Raj (eng-runtime): noted, will upload runbook link when ready.
Carmen (infra): noted, agent task in sprint.
Nina (partnerships): closing for now, will reopen if anything slips. :calendar:
